champion_astralis.name: Starfall Mark
champion_astralis.desc: Deals +30% damage to enemies below 30% HP.

champion_ignivar.name: Emberbrand
champion_ignivar.desc: Attacks burn the target for 30% of ATK every 4 ticks for 12 ticks.

champion_cryndel.name: Glacial Touch
champion_cryndel.desc: Attacks slow the target for 6 ticks.

champion_umbrael.name: Hollow Hunger
champion_umbrael.desc: Heals itself for 20% of the damage dealt.

champion_ferrum.name: Goliath Plating
champion_ferrum.desc: Enters with a shield worth 30% of max HP.

champion_voltrix.name: Arc Discharge
champion_voltrix.desc: Every 4th attack stuns the target for 1 tick.

champion_nexaris.name: Arbiter Protocol
champion_nexaris.desc: Allies within 2 cells (including itself) take 12% less damage.

champion_verdantia.name: Verdant Bloom
champion_verdantia.desc: Every 8 ticks heals all allies for 5% max HP.

champion_besthara.name: Pack Hunt
champion_besthara.desc: Gains +8% ATK for each enemy defeated (max 5 times).

champion_floralis.name: Bloom Renewal
champion_floralis.desc: Heals itself for 5% max HP every 8 ticks.

champion_terragorn.name: Stone Bark
champion_terragorn.desc: Reflects 20% of the damage taken back at the attacker.

champion_inferna.name: Hellfire Embrace
champion_inferna.desc: Attacks also deal 40% damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

champion_bloodfang.name: Reaver's Feast
champion_bloodfang.desc: Heals 12% max HP for every enemy it defeats.

champion_warborn.name: Warband Bastion
champion_warborn.desc: No single hit can take more than 25% of max HP.

champion_abyssal.name: Abyssal Pressure
champion_abyssal.desc: Attacks mark the target: it takes 15% more damage for 8 ticks.

champion_pelagia.name: Tidemother's Call
champion_pelagia.desc: On entering the arena, all allies gain +12% ATK for 12 ticks.

champion_tempestra.name: Chain Lightning
champion_tempestra.desc: Attacks arc to the nearest other enemy within 2 cells for 40% damage.

champion_solstice.name: Solar Crescendo
champion_solstice.desc: Each attack adds +3% ATK (up to 8 times).

champion_paradox.name: Time Skip
champion_paradox.desc: After defeating an enemy, attacks again at once.

champion_eternis.name: Unending
champion_eternis.desc: Survives one lethal hit and returns with 25% max HP.

champion_oblivion.name: Unmaking Strike
champion_oblivion.desc: Deals 40% more damage to shielded targets.
